discovery.themeModule: A client chunk containing the external-store subscribe helper, the snapshot accessor before it, and the appearance-mode setter that suppresses transitions; chunk name and aliases are discovered by scripts/discover.py and rendered into host.mjs. The chunk hash is recorded in the install receipt, not pinned.
discovery.onFailure: Installation still proceeds (the overlay only adds its own files); the addon shows a dismissible note that it could not attach.
